title: 2026 UK ETS waste voluntary MRV scope and reporting controls

sources.title: Voluntary monitoring reporting and verification period for EfW and waste incineration

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme (UK ETS): technical guidance and tools

facts.source_fact: The voluntary waste MRV-only period started on 1 January 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Require reporting periods to respect the 1 January 2026 start.

facts.source_fact: The UK ETS Authority announced an intention for the MRV-only period to run from 2026 to 2028.
facts.expected_handling: Store this as an announced intention, not as a fabricated statutory end date.

facts.source_fact: Participation in the MRV-only period is voluntary.
facts.expected_handling: Do not classify participation as a current legal obligation.

facts.source_fact: The guidance states there is no fee payable to the regulator for participation.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer a regulator participation fee.

facts.source_fact: The guidance states there is no penalty for non-participation.
facts.expected_handling: Do not create penalty exposure for voluntary non-participation.

facts.source_fact: Participation is strongly encouraged to help operators understand emissions, future cost exposure and the UK ETS.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the distinction between encouraged participation and legal compulsion.

facts.source_fact: Participating operators need to create a voluntary monitoring plan.
facts.expected_handling: Require a monitoring-plan state for participating installations.

facts.source_fact: Participants need to monitor emissions in line with their voluntary monitoring plan.
facts.expected_handling: Reject evidence that is not linked to the approved/used monitoring approach.

facts.source_fact: Participants submit emissions to regulators through an annual emissions report.
facts.expected_handling: Keep annual emissions reporting separate from quarterly data-template submissions.

facts.source_fact: Operators are encouraged to have the annual emissions report verified.
facts.expected_handling: Represent verification as encouraged in the voluntary period, not automatically completed.

facts.source_fact: Non-hazardous waste incineration is in scope above 3 tonnes of waste per hour.
facts.expected_handling: Apply the greater-than 3 t/hour threshold exactly.

facts.source_fact: Hazardous waste incineration is in scope above 10 tonnes of waste per day.
facts.expected_handling: Apply the greater-than 10 t/day threshold exactly.

facts.source_fact: Clinical waste is included in scope.
facts.expected_handling: Do not exclude clinical waste categorically.

facts.source_fact: A high-temperature hazardous-waste exclusion requires capability to operate at 1,100°C for 2 seconds.
facts.expected_handling: Do not apply the high-temperature exclusion without both temperature and duration conditions.

facts.source_fact: The high-temperature exclusion also requires at least 80% hazardous waste by annual input.
facts.expected_handling: Require the hazardous-waste share condition alongside the temperature condition.

facts.source_fact: The exclusion specifies no more than 20% healthcare waste.
facts.expected_handling: Do not apply the exclusion if healthcare-waste share exceeds 20%.

facts.source_fact: The exclusion specifies no more than 1% hazardous waste wood.
facts.expected_handling: Do not apply the exclusion if hazardous waste wood exceeds 1%.

facts.source_fact: Operators should contact their regulator to request participation guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Route participation workflow through the applicable regulator.

facts.source_fact: The VMRVP01 guidance was revised on 5 May 2026 to include preliminary and biomass-fraction emission factors in its Annex.
facts.expected_handling: Version-pin waste factor logic to the revised guidance rather than silently using an older annex.

facts.source_fact: The UK ETS Waste Quarterly Data Report template was updated with the quarter 2 version on 26 June 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Use the current Q2 template for quarter-2 voluntary-period submissions.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach the applicable accounting/scheme boundary before downstream use.
Attach reference year, publication/update date and provisional/final status where applicable.
Carry source URL, publisher and method/provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert this document/method rule into a parcel-level measured emission without a separate parcel-binding gate.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
